instruction: Name the artist least recommended to me on Spotify.

arguments.code:
print('logging in...');
spotify_pw=[x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
print('spotify_pw_loaded', bool(spotify_pw))
resp=apis.spotify.login(username='timothy.whit@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)
print(resp)

access_token='';
# retrieve from previous login if available
try:
    access_token=locals()['resp']['access_token']
except Exception:
    access_token=None
print('have_token', bool(access_token))
if not access_token:
    spotify_pw=[x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
    resp=apis.spotify.login(username='timothy.whit@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)
    access_token=resp['access_token']

recs=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page', page_index, 'count', len(page) if page is not None else None)
    if not page:
        break
    recs.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print('total_recs', len(recs))
# aggregate artist counts
from collections import defaultdict
counts=defaultdict(int)
name_by_id={}
for song in recs:
    for a in song.get('artists', []):
        aid=a.get('id')
        aname=a.get('name')
        if aid is None:
            aid=aname
        counts[aid]+=1
        name_by_id[aid]=aname
# find min
min_count=min(counts.values())
least=[aid for aid,c in counts.items() if c==min_count]
least_names=sorted([name_by_id[aid] for aid in least if name_by_id.get(aid) is not None])
print('min_count', min_count)
print('least_candidates', least_names)
# print all counts sorted ascending then name
sorted_table=sorted([(counts[aid], name_by_id.get(aid)) for aid in counts], key=lambda x:(x[0], x[1] or ''))
print('bottom_10', sorted_table[:10])
print('answer', least_names[0] if least_names else None)
